folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B216, 2026-11-04
folds.body: The full proof-routing note was reviewed. Preserve the earned native journey, six-pelt debit and real first craft receipt separately from harness recovery and later presentation-only refresh. The historical readiness file is not a second natural acquisition journey or a substitute user save. Original BROWSER_EVIDENCE and later FINAL_REFRESH bind different scopes/bytes; a later whole/reload/UI check does not repeat every original earned prerequisite. Pure10,000-kill stress and all-five-species serialized replay prove their source owner, not10,000 native combat kills or long-running browser overflow. Long native auto-fight remains in its backlog until matching evidence exists. No profile, export, image, script or browser was reopened or executed by B216 (AD32/AD36).

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B216, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The entire five-step acceptance plan was read as a plan, not a completed native recovery receipt. Its extended corpus checker had AST syntax evidence only; running it and qualifying repaired Splitter/Inserter/address/ABI/merge joins remained distinct future steps. ARM through1850 and initial Intel through84 describe valid historical snapshots, not the final repaired bounds by inference. Byte identity, attempted function, generated C, resolved control flow, qualified field layout and understood semantics need different evidence. Pcode, mini-program success, suppressed errors or raised resource limits do not replace missing high-level C (AD32/AD36).

Retain the no-repeat rule for unchanged evidence and refresh consequential joins only when changed. Architecture corpora/retained tool provenance are separate from installed2.0.77 API/DLC claims, experimental2.1.21 and entitlement. A whole export does not establish a buildable original C++ project or whole-binary reading. The retort’s code/native/UI/build record here explicitly remained implemented-unverified for gameplay/browser/save/failure gates. Historical writer leases, scripts and outgoing-disposition instructions grant no current launch, message or corpus mutation. Current tool registry is the entry point for any separately selected new tool work; B216 executes none.
